title: This deck is a folder of text files

buildSteps.label: The deck
buildSteps.description: You are looking at the folder tutorial/. Its presentation.json lists the slides, in sections.

buildSteps.label: A slide
buildSteps.description: Each slide is a folder inside the deck's slides folder. Its content.json says which layout the slide uses, and holds its text.

buildSteps.label: A task
buildSteps.description: Some slides ask you to edit a file. Save it: this page reloads by itself, and the task marks itself done.

buildSteps.label: Or ask
buildSteps.description: Every task also shows what to say to a coding agent, which then makes the edit for you.
